official_title: Texas Sales and Use Tax Resale Certificate (Texas Comptroller Form 01-339, Front)

pdf_architecture.notes: 2-page PDF: Page 1 is the Resale Certificate (01-339 front); Page 2 is the Exemption Certificate (01-339 back). Keep 11-digit Texas Taxpayer Numbers as Text to avoid Excel scientific notation.

columns.pdf_field_example: Page 1: Name of purchaser, firm or agency as shown on permit
columns.format_notes: Exact legal name registered on the Texas Sales and Use Tax Permit.

columns.pdf_field_example: Page 1: Address (Street & number, P.O. Box or Route number)

columns.format_notes: Purchaser city, state, and ZIP (preserve leading zeros).

columns.pdf_field_example: Page 1: Texas Sales and Use Tax Permit Number (11 digits)
columns.format_notes: 11-digit Texas Taxpayer Number (strictly synthetic 3000000000x in examples). Must be Text formatted or Excel converts it to 3.00E+10.
Used only by out-of-state retailers without a Texas permit.
Home state/country of the out-of-state retailer.
Wholesale vendor/distributor name (typically constant across a distributor's onboarding batch).

columns.pdf_field_example: Page 1: Description of items to be purchased on the attached order or invoice
columns.format_notes: Specific description of tangible goods or taxable services purchased for resale.

columns.pdf_field_example: Page 1: Description of the type of business activity generally engaged in or type of items normally sold by the purchaser
columns.format_notes: General description of what the purchaser sells, leases, or rents in the regular course of business.
Authorized officer, owner, or buyer signing the certificate.
